title: Vanishing signed Hamming tail coefficient
statement: For every real number $t$, consider the uniform sign cube of dimension $m+1$, the sum of its coordinates divided by $\sqrt{m+1}$, and the indicator of the event that this normalized sum exceeds $t$. Twice the absolute value of the Fourier coefficient of this indicator at the singleton consisting of the first coordinate tends to $0$ as $m\to\infty$.
